svg.title: Flow rates per move against the survival requirement — every legal policy sits just below the line
svg.desc: Flow rates per move against the survival requirement — every legal policy sits just below the line. Requirement markers are the exact disc-conservation rates 2.400 = 12/5 numbered clears and 1.400 = 7/5 covered reveals per move (finding-01); the generator has no reference-line primitive, so each requirement is drawn as a dot in every category. Cohorts differ per category and are named in the category labels: 64g = 64 games on cohort 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f (development); 256g = 256 fresh games (RS-20260823T131226Z-16564ed9 frozenArmFreshBaseline); 128t / 32t / 64t = fresh master tapes in finding-12; 6000mv = 6,000 clairvoyant moves in finding-06. The two fair-D4-s7 points are the same policy on different cohorts and are separate categories, not a pooled value. The H=5 planner point is the 128-fresh-tape figure; the H=7 planner point is the 32-fresh-tape matched-cohort figure. Only the privileged clairvoyant planners reach the requirement; every legal policy clusters just under it. Evidence tier: mixed per source (development screens and exploratory mechanism studies); this chart assembles separate experiments, it does not pool them. Sources: docs/exploratory/finding-05-chance-strata.md, RS-20260821T192140Z-189fe392, docs/exploratory/finding-08-learned-leaf.md, docs/exploratory/finding-12-fair-planner-ceiling-extended.md, RS-20260823T131226Z-16564ed9, docs/exploratory/finding-06-flow-ceiling.md, docs/exploratory/finding-01-score-is-survival.md.
